chunks: 4374 - Al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah narrated from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام, who said:

In the last days and with the approach of the Hour, which will be the worst of times, women will appear who are uncovering, naked, and displaying themselves. They will be outside the religion, entering into trials, inclining toward desires, hastening toward pleasures, and deeming the forbidden to be permissible; in Jahannam they shall abide forever.

key_terms.آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ: the final period before the end of worldly history
key_terms.السَّاعَةِ: the Hour, meaning the onset of qiyamah
key_terms.مُتَبَرِّجَاتٌ: women displaying their adornment openly and immodestly

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about moral corruption and women at the end of times?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a sign of the end times in the form of widespread moral corruption and public immodesty. It warns against indulgence in desires, involvement in fitan, and treating haram as halal, while emphasizing the severe consequence in the afterlife.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4374 - Al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah narrated from Commander of the Faithful (as) that he said:

In the last days and near the Hour, when it will be the worst of times, there will appear women who are uncovered, naked, and flaunting themselves.
They will outwardly belong to the religion but will be immersed in trials, inclined toward desires, hastening toward pleasures, and making permissible what is forbidden. They will dwell in Hell forever."
